stem:
Dev has a length of 3 tenths of a metre on a measuring strip marked in tenths and hundredths.

Which statement describes the same length?

options.text: The length is 3 hundredths of a metre.
The length is 3 thousandths of a metre, ignoring regrouping by tens.
The length is 30 hundredths of a metre, because ten hundredths make one tenth.
The length is 3 metres, because the strip shows the digit 3 most clearly.

teacher.key_rationale: Ten hundredths make one tenth, so 3 tenths equal 30 hundredths. Calling them hundredths without the factor of ten swaps the place. Skipping regrouping by tens breaks the place-value link. The digit 3 alone is not the measure.
